findings.title: تحذير طبي.. أقسام العناية المركزة مهددة بالتوقف في غزة
findings.location: Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis; Gaza Strip hospitals
findings.affected_population_system: Ahmed al-Farra, identified by Alghad as director of Nasser Medical Complex, warned that ICU services and surgery are at risk of stopping due to shortages of basic supplies. He reported syringe shortages leading some to reuse them, raising infection risks. This is a named clinician's warning, not confirmation of an ICU shutdown or independently verified reuse prevalence.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: أقسام العناية المركزة باتت معرضة للتوقف عن العمل بسبب نقص المواد الأساسية.
findings.source_type: Established broadcaster reporting direct interview with named hospital official

bounded_discovery_context.method: Followed related healthcare report from Alghad casualty search result; read full article and compared against 17 authenticated prior ledgers.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Specific ICU shutdown risk and syringe shortages not identified in reviewed prior ledgers; distinct from previously logged generator maintenance and pediatric admission/transfer issues.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Source shows 14:55 on November 26 without explicit timezone; likely published before this discovery window. Exact interview time and independent corroboration unavailable.
